description: Frozen B41 checkpoint. Inference-only ablation of particle initialization and interacting transport. No retraining, no ranking, no oracle, no retry. Full interacting transport is the existing D0 B41 row; this job samples the three stripped variants.
hypothesis: Interacting particle transport raises any@k coverage over iid independent latents across the budget curve, not only at k=20.
claim_if_pass: particle coverage is a method contribution: keep interacting transport in the paper mechanism
claim_if_fail: particles are an implementation detail; do not sell interacting transport as a second contribution
independent_transport: condition-flow Euler only; no repulsion; no RMS spread floor
interacting_transport: B41 repulsion + RMS spread floor after each flow step
